C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6.IntentSummary:
T1 plan for C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6, authored from the approved spec (SHA-256 `c3a9487823d8e6276ad2602ffbde6a6f62e0d933fef72065f7ef0636f05d81b4`) at base commit `06996d65dff05e53c7b18fae93a017d55c8c2d55`. Three mechanisms, one bundle: retire the declaration-count guard and the `validate` job's `fetch-depth: 0` (the two ends of one mechanism), replace the committed `test-metrics.json` cache with a raw JUnit report generated afresh for every `test:metrics` invocation, and upload the current report from CI without masking the suite's failure. The owning module is `M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION` (`scripts/test-metrics.ts` and `scripts/test-affected.ts` each declare `LINKS: [M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION, V-M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION]`), with `V-M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION` as its verification sibling.
**Ordering.** T-001 retires the guard, the depth assertion, the JSON import, and the metrics lines in the `prepin fixture discovery` test from `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts`, and retitles the README-only describe and the prepin test. T-002 replaces `scripts/test-metrics.ts` and `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts` together and depends on T-001: T-001 removes the `artifactIsStale` import while T-002 removes the export, so the write paths are disjoint but the read dependency is real. A disposable export-removal probe produced `Export named 'artifactIsStale' not found` with exit 1 before the import was removed and exit 0 after. T-003 deletes `test-metrics.json` and the dead `AFFECTED_EDGES` entry and depends on T-001 and T-002, because both the audit suite and the runner must stop reading the artifact first. T-004 updates `.github/workflows/validate.yml` and depends on T-002, the runner it configures. T-005 updates `README.md` and depends on T-003 and T-004, because it documents their landed behavior and the deletion. The executor runs the graph sequentially with no concurrent workers, branches, or worktrees.
**Checkpoint.** The source/diff baseline is `06996d…`; this plan was authored at checkpoint `91bfcdeb47fb54ea9c0129768f9d671ba9a6d4c9` against the approved spec (SHA-256 `c3a9487823d8e6276ad2602ffbde6a6f62e0d933fef72065f7ef0636f05d81b4`). The runner's new behavior has not been implemented or exercised; the old `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts` passing at the checkpoint is not evidence of the future behavior, and no current CI pass is claimed. The authority reruns the read-only structural and byte checks on the final worktree before apply, without introducing a second suite.
**All 15 approved `AC-*` are close-bound with complete `CloseEvidence`**, so no task carries `<Satisfies>` — a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is an error, and a close-bound criterion is not a forgotten mapping. The one full CI-equivalent run is this plan's `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` (`bun run validate:ci`) under `--assertions final --run-commands`, before apply/archive; no task `Verification` and no `CloseEvidence` command in the bundle names the root suite or `validate:ci`. The post-archive verdict runs only the focused `CloseEvidence` commands and the combined pinned-base tracked-plus-nonignored-untracked inventory. The close writes this bundle's own archive arrival; `ObservedWriteScope` names the seven production paths, the active run ledger artifacts, and the archive arrival glob. No record entry is paid and no record XML is flushed. No `Clarifications` are open, and no `OutOfPlanScope` is needed because `AffectedAreas` names only `M-RELEASE-AUTOMATION`, which `DurableScope` covers.

T-001.Title: Retire the declaration-count guard and depth assertion from the audit suite

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `scripts/audit-regressions.test.ts` removes exactly the `import { artifactIsStale } from "./test-metrics";` line, `COVERAGE_BASE` with its preceding comment banner, `declaredTests`, `coverageRegressions`, the `C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-2-3EC1F016 coverage never falls` describe and its test, `validateJobCheckoutDepth` with its doc comment, and the depth `it` inside the `C-LINUX-VALIDATION-REPAIR-1-DE5A1A05 checkout and README guards` describe. It also removes the `const metrics = ...`, the `artifactIsStale` assertions, and the `planted`/`rmSync` lines from inside the `prepin fixture discovery` test. It changes no other symbol or assertion.

The `C-LINUX-VALIDATION-REPAIR-1-DE5A1A05 checkout and README guards` describe is retitled `C-LINUX-VALIDATION-REPAIR-1-DE5A1A05 README guard` and keeps only its README test. The `prepin fixture discovery` test is retitled to `prepin fixture discovery finds no test files`, and its walker assertion `expect(walk(dir).some((full) => full.endsWith(".test.ts"))).toBe(false)` stays.

Retained and green: `collectTestFiles`, `validateCiRerunsSuite` and the `C-TEST-TIME-BUDGET-2-3EC1F016 validate:ci one suite run` describe, the README guard, the `prepin CI retirement` guard, the `prepin fixture discovery` fixture-walker test, and every unrelated assertion. No replacement declaration-count, test-count, or test-volume guard is added.

Discrimination belongs to the pinned-base byte reconstruction in `Verification`, not to the suite alone. On a faithful post-T-001 copy the reconstruction accepts the exact approved transform (the three deletions, the two retitles, and the metrics-region removal) and rejects a planted `COVERAGE_BASE` line, a deleted retained README guard statement, and any unrelated appended byte; restoring the transform is accepted again. The focused audit suite is a precondition, not the discriminating instrument: deleting the retained README `it` left it green (94 pass/0 fail), byte restoration returned 95 pass/0 fail, and restoring an unused retired `COVERAGE_BASE` also stayed green. No permanent audit test, count/coverage guard, sidecar, or helper source file is added.

T-002.Title: Replace the committed metrics cache with the one-suite raw-JUnit runner and its behavioral tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `scripts/test-metrics.ts` no longer contains `artifactIsStale`, `sourceCount`, a `schemaVersion`/`sourceDigest`/`group` field, the provisional tree-derived artifact, the no-write-when-fresh branch, or any committed-JSON reader or writer. It keeps an exported parser (`parseJUnit`) and ranking (`rankSlowest`), and its module map matches its exports. It spawns the inner suite exactly once (`bun test --timeout=0 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=<report>`) and exits with the child's exact OS status.

Report-path policy: the runner resolves `NGRACE_TEST_REPORT_PATH` when set, else a fresh unique directory under `os.tmpdir()` outside the repository. Before any `mkdir`, unlink, or spawn it canonicalizes (resolves) the target and refuses with a diagnostic nonzero when the resolved path is inside the repository — including an override whose parent is a symlink resolving inside, or a path escaping through `..`. A lexical prefix check is not the check. On an accepted path it creates a missing parent directory, removes any file already at the report path, prints the report path, prints the top-10 slowest ranking parsed from that run's report, and leaves the produced report in place.

Refusal paths: a successful child whose current report is missing, unreadable, or malformed exits nonzero with a diagnostic and prints no ranking, reusing no previous report; a Bun launch failure or a child with no usable status exits nonzero with a diagnostic and is not retried. A failing child's exact exit code survives a missing or malformed report, and any report bytes produced are retained. Parsing stays minimal: `<testcase>` file, name, and time, with no generalized schema or threshold.

No general framework, test-only seam, count floor, second suite, or fixture sidecar is added. A green test file alone is not evidence: the task report pastes the captured stdout, stderr, direct exits, report contents, attempt counts, and file bytes. The behavior tests and the refusal probes are authored here; they have not existed before, so no prior run is claimed.

T-003.Title: Delete the committed metrics artifact and its dead selective-runner edge

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `test-metrics.json` is removed from the working tree; the new runner has no reader or writer for it, so a subsequent `test:metrics` run does not recreate it.

`scripts/test-affected.ts` equals the pinned base with only the `"test-metrics.json": ["scripts/test-metrics.test.ts"]` edge removed; the `README.md` and `.github/workflows/validate.yml` edges and every other byte stay unchanged. The exact-byte comparison in `Verification` is the discriminating instrument.
`scripts/test-affected.test.ts` passes unmodified, and a planted `test-metrics.json` is neither read nor written by the runner.

T-004.Title: Retire the validate checkout depth and add the report environment and upload

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: In `.github/workflows/validate.yml` the `validate` job's Checkout step is `uses: actions/checkout@v5` with no `with:` block and no `fetch-depth`, matching the `windows-compatibility` job's Checkout. The `windows-compatibility` and `dart-adapter` checkouts are unchanged, and `.github/workflows/publish.yml` keeps its three `fetch-depth: 0` declarations.

The `validate` job sets the environment variable `NGRACE_TEST_REPORT_PATH` to `${{ runner.temp }}/ngrace-test-reports/junit.xml` so the `test:metrics` run inside `bun run validate:ci` writes the current report there.

The `validate` job adds an upload step that uses the official `actions/upload-artifact` action at the current verified major (re-verified against the action's upstream release before the workflow is written; `v7` per the approved spec's `Assumptions`), uploads exactly `${{ runner.temp }}/ngrace-test-reports/junit.xml`, sets `if: always()`, sets `if-no-files-found: ignore`, sets no `continue-on-error`, uploads no unrelated temporary data, and cannot change the job's failure outcome. Its step name is not one of the retired validate step names.

Configuration is established by the parsed `jobs.validate` check in `Verification`, which compares the parsed workflow with the pinned base and allows only the Checkout input removal, the validate job report env, and one checked upload step after the CI step; it rejects a comment-only token with the real env/upload absent, a wrong upload condition or path, a report env moved to another job, an empty or extra Checkout input, an unexpected upload field, and any other structural change. The retained `prepin CI retirement` guard stays green as a secondary check, driven both ways on a throwaway copy (a planted retired pre-pin step or a `prepin-behavior`/`b53d13d` marker reddens it; a restore is green). This check establishes workflow configuration, not GitHub's runtime job outcome or report availability. No other job's checkout, `publish.yml`, or `package.json` changes.

T-005.Title: Document the per-run report and override in README

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `README.md`'s `bun run test:metrics` line describes the single-suite run that writes a fresh raw JUnit report to a path outside the repository and names the `NGRACE_TEST_REPORT_PATH` override; it no longer says the command writes `test-metrics.json`.

`README.md` equals the pinned base with only that one line replaced by exactly `bun run test:metrics # single suite; fresh raw JUnit report outside the repository (override: NGRACE_TEST_REPORT_PATH)`; the product-version line, CLI Overview rows, and measurement cell are unchanged, no other README byte moves, and `examples/` is untouched. The exact-byte comparison in `Verification` is the discriminating instrument.
The README-reading guards stay green, and the plan's `MustContain`/`MustNotContain` assertions on `README.md` hold at `--assertions final`.

Assumptions.Assumption: The source/diff baseline is `06996d65dff05e53c7b18fae93a017d55c8c2d55`; this plan was authored at checkpoint `91bfcdeb47fb54ea9c0129768f9d671ba9a6d4c9` against the approved spec whose SHA-256 is `c3a9487823d8e6276ad2602ffbde6a6f62e0d933fef72065f7ef0636f05d81b4`. The runner's new behaviors and the `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts` titles do not yet exist and have never been implemented or exercised; the old `scripts/test-metrics.test.ts` passing at the checkpoint is not evidence of the future behavior. Prior evidence covers only Bun/JUnit mechanics on a disposable fixture, the combined pinned-base Git command, and the appendix structural/byte checks on disposable copies, not product runner behavior, and no current CI pass is claimed. Every runner behavior and refusal probe in T-002 is owed to implementation.

The close writes only this bundle's own archive arrival; the bundle pays no record entry and flushes no record XML. `ObservedWriteScope` therefore names the seven production paths, the active run ledger artifacts, and the archive arrival glob, and the `AC-WRITE-SURFACE-BOUNDED` combined command is evaluated in the applied-archive state.
